gloss: rain shelter; rain guard; rain cover

definitions.gloss: rain shelter; rain guard; rain cover
definitions.explanation: Something that provides protection from rain — a shelter, awning, cover, or other structure or device that keeps rain off.

examples.english: I waited under a rain shelter.

examples.japanese: ⟦ベビーカー→ベビーカー：11154_bebiikaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{雨|あま}よけ⟦カバー→カバー：07812_kabaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけた→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I put a rain cover on the stroller.

examples.japanese: ⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{雨|あま}よけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{庇|ひさし}→庇：16002_hisashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{出|だ}し{入|い}れ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{濡|ぬ}れなくて→濡れる：00800_nureru⟧⟦{済|す}む→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: There's a rain awning over the entrance, so I don't get wet when bringing things in and out.

notes:
Composed of {雨|あま} (rain) + ⟦よけ→よけ：28839_yoke⟧ (avoidance, protection). The suffix ⟦よけ→よけ：28839_yoke⟧ ({除|よ}け) means protection against or warding off, and combines with many nouns to describe protective measures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雨|あま}よけ⟦カバー→カバー：07812_kabaa⟧: rain cover
- {雨|あま}よけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{庇|ひさし}→庇：16002_hisashi⟧: rain awning
- {雨|あま}よけ⟦テント→テント：03859_tento⟧: rain shelter tent
- {雨|あま}よけ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to serve as rain protection

- ⟦{風|かぜ}よけ→風よけ：23781_kazeyoke⟧: windbreak
